# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_CONTRACTION_FILTER_ADJUSTMENT

**Filed:** 2026-08-24
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** filter_change
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Adjusting the ribbon spread threshold for the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup from a fixed 30 cents to a volatility-adjusted threshold (e.g., 0.5x 20-bar ATR) will improve edge capture by filtering out low-probability signals in compressed ribbons (low volatility) while maintaining sensitivity during expansion phases (high volatility), thereby increasing win rate on J's winner days and reducing false signals on loser days.

## Mechanism

Replace the fixed ribbon spread ≥ 30 cents condition in BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON context filters with: ribbon spread must be ≥ (0.5 * 20-bar ATR of SPY). ATR calculated using standard true range on SPY 5-minute bars. Entry allowed only when current ribbon spread (Fast EMA - Slow EMA) meets or exceeds this dynamic threshold. All other context filters (time, structure, VIX, volume divergence) and exit logic (chart stop, chandelier profit-lock, premium stop, time stop) remain unchanged.
